[SWS_DM_00329] Lifecycle management of an
UDS
Transport Protocol imple-
mentation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
The lifecycle of an UDS Transport Protocol implementation shall be managed by the
DM in the following order:
• Creation of the UDS Transport Protocol implementation by calling its con-
structor
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHan-
dler::UdsTransportProtocolHandler
.
• Initializing of the UDS Transport Protocol implementation by calling
apext::
diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Initial-
ize
.
• Starting of the UDS Transport Protocol implementation by calling
apext::
diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Start
.
• Stopping of the UDS Transport Protocol implementation by calling
apext::
diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Stop
.
⌋
